reason: docs/guides/server/update-compatibility.adoc:122-123 says exit code 1 means the metadata file is missing or corrupt. But UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:80 and :90 throw PropertyException in those cases, and ExecutionExceptionHandler.java:44-50 turns a PropertyException into getInvalidInputExitCode. No exit-code mapper is set, so that falls back to exitCodeOnInvalidInput, which is picocli's default of 2 (ShortErrorMessageHandler.java:98-101).
